description: C4 (decisions C4-1..C4-6): the hold-outs' camp beyond the rim grows into a hold because of what only a colossus can do - great timbers hauled from the Windfall for the hall's roof-tree, king-stones carried from the toppled pier of the Kings' Causeway for a ring of stone, the rockfall heaved off the path, the trolls driven off the crags, the raid beaten back, the pilgrims fetched home - each tier earned by its projects and raised at its site by the giant himself. The tier's work shows when he raises it; its life (folk, fires, smoke, banners, the garrison) comes once he has gone beyond settle_m, behind his back (A3-4's rule).

timber.name: great timber
timber.from: the Windfall west of the camp, where the old kings' frost-killed pines lie as they fell

kingstone.name: king-stone
kingstone.from: the toppled pier of the Kings' Causeway, north-east of the camp: its drums lie in a line where they fell

tiers.name: The Camp
tiers.text: Hide tents behind a dry-stone windbreak and a hall with no roof: what is left of the rim-folk who would not turn raider. A man could not lift its roof-tree. A colossus could.

tiers.name: The Roofed Hall
tiers.text: The hall stands roofed again, its roof-tree a pine the giant carried, its turf laid by the hold-outs; a fire burns in it.
tiers.settled_text: Folk have come in from the passes: the hall is full and its fire is lit.

unlocks.text: Rest by the hall's fire: health, stamina and essence restored, and the Hearth keeps your place.
Folk come in from the passes: four more hold-outs in the camp.
Maera's stores trade: three hides for an iron ingot.
A roofed hall is worth burning: the Rimward will come for the Hearth.

projects.name: Roof the hall
projects.text: The hall's walls stand but its roof fell in the winter the rim split. Its roof-tree must be a whole pine, and only the old kings' wood has pines that big - lying in the Windfall since the frost killed them.
projects.raised_text: The roof-tree drops into its crucks. The hold-outs swarm up it with turf before you have straightened.

needs.text: Haul two great timbers to the hall
Hides for the hall's door and roof
Heave the rockfall off the Hearth path

tiers.name: The Stone Ring
tiers.text: A ring of king-stones closes the camp's open side, the old kings' own masonry set by a colossus's hands; archers keep platforms on it, and a forge burns inside.
tiers.settled_text: The ring is manned: four archers keep its platforms, banners fly at its gate and the forge is lit.

unlocks.text: The Hearth's forge: a titan forge that works Stoneback's stone, the Ogre King's trophies, the Rootwarden's bark and the Warden's stone.
Four archers on the ring's platforms loose beside you at anything that comes for the Hearth.
The hold-outs raise a waystone on the Hoarwatch, above the Colossus Steps.
The forge trades four iron ingots for a bar of titan iron.

projects.name: Raise the stone ring
projects.text: The windbreak keeps out the wind, not the Rimward. The old kings' causeway lies broken north-east of the camp, every drum of it a stone a hundred men could not roll.
projects.raised_text: The last king-stone grinds down into its bed. The ring is closed.

needs.text: Haul three king-stones to the ring
Drive the trolls off the Hoar Crags

projects.name: Build the Hearth's forge
projects.text: Maera's smith works on a flat stone by the fire. Give her an anvil-stone no fire can crack and the iron to start a forge, and the titans' parts you carry can be worked beyond the rim.
projects.raised_text: The anvil-stone settles. The smith is already laying her coals.

needs.text: Haul a king-stone for the anvil

tiers.name: The Hearth-hold
tiers.text: A hold now, not a camp: a beacon tower over the ring that can be seen from the Breach, a colossus-sized anvil outside its gate, the pilgrims home.
tiers.settled_text: The beacon burns. The pilgrims are home and the hold's stall is open.

unlocks.text: The Colossus Anvil: a colossus forge that rimforges a titanforged weapon to fit stages 7 and 8.
Six archers, and the beacon tower's great bow, loose beside you.
The pilgrims are home: the hold's folk number fourteen.
The beacon's watchers see what moves on the Hoarcrown: a lead toward the Frostbound Titan.

projects.name: Raise the hold's beacon
projects.text: A beacon the Breach can see, so the next raid is seen coming. Its tower is king-stone and its crown a whole pine - and it must wait until the Hearth has shown it can hold.
projects.raised_text: The crown-timber goes up into its seat on the tower. Someone is already climbing with fire.

needs.text: Haul a king-stone for the tower
Haul a great timber for its crown
Beat back the Rimward's raid on the Hearth
Fetch the pilgrims home: drive off the dire pack on their track

projects.name: Raise the Colossus Anvil
projects.text: No forge has made a weapon for a body your size since the kings. The smith says she can, on an anvil you can stand at - a king-stone on its bed outside the gate - with titan iron to temper it.
projects.raised_text: The great anvil beds down outside the gate. The smith climbs onto it to look at your weapon.

needs.text: Haul a king-stone for the anvil
